name: full_charge
description: The whole curve, end to end: a Level 1 (1.4 kW) charge from 15 % to full on a healthy 60 Ah pack, so the flat CC phase is long and the taper knee sits high (~86 %). This is the scenario to point a power-vs-time chart at. Runs at REAL TIME (1x), like every shipped scenario bar degradation_arc: compress it yourself with --speed, or with the cockpit's Time card, so the clock is always one you chose (docs/SIMULATOR.md, 'Compressing time'). The whole charge is ~16 hours at 1x; `--speed 240` puts it into about four minutes.
